issue.title: edit strips trailing whitespace from new_text but reports success.

steps: Unpack our README: run `echo  | base64 -d | tar xz`. In README.md the three contact lines under "## Contact" render as one run-on line on GitHub. Make each of them render on its own line using Markdown hard line breaks (two trailing spaces at the end of the first two lines) - don't add blank lines or change anything else. Tell me when it's done.
expected: Replacement text preserves intentional Markdown trailing spaces.
defect: edit strips trailing whitespace from new_text but reports success.

fault location.explanation: Replacement text is normalized under the original file whitespace policy.

Root cause: Source confirmed: apply_matches normalizes replacement text using a preserve_trailing_ws flag inherited from the original file. When the original has no trailing whitespace, intended Markdown hard-break spaces disappear. The one archived exploration shows the model detects this and repairs via perl; final output is correct. This is tool-level evidence, not ten failed end-to-end tasks. No fresh runtime reproduction was performed during this organization. Exact first fixing commit has not been established. Root steps describe the selected original case; other run-local cases can differ. Retained observations are not automatically independent same-prompt trials.
